description: Scope a coding job. WHEN: you want Dead Brands (Perry or Rock) to write code. Describe the job; the broker suggests a size/difficulty tier (longer/harder costs more) and three term options: pay, barter, or free. Terms stay TBD until Perry or Rock accepts — nothing is guaranteed at scoping. Staged behind coding_jobs_enabled (separate from the cash-market barter_broker_enabled flag). Returns CODEJOBS_OFF until that flag is on. Example: barter_code_scope {}

brief.description: What you want built or fixed, max 2000 chars.

tier_hint.description: Optional hint; the broker still suggests a tier from the brief.

name: barter_code_scope
title: Coding job: scope a brief
